halha: jalja' — (inferred) rushing water; jal 'change, move' + ja' 'water', as 010's hal ha; Brasseur 'eaux bouillonnantes'
molai: Molai — Molai; the birds between which the twins passed, known only from this line; kept as a name, respelled by the letters
puhia: Pujia — Puhia; a river, puh 'pus' + ia 'water, river' (Brasseur Pa-puh-ya 'the river of pus'; inferred); kept as a name, respelled by the letters
quiquia: Kikia — Quiquia; a river, quic 'blood' + ia 'water, river' (Brasseur Quiq-ya 'the river of blood'; inferred); kept as a name, respelled by the letters
chacbal: chakb'al — (inferred) means of defeating; chac 'defeat, beat' + -b'al, the noun of means or place
yicou: yik'ow — (inferred) they crossed, waded; the icou 'pass' verb with a glide y before the vowel (mavi xqui yicou 'they did not wade across'); Brasseur x-qui yiqou, with his q for ꜭ
ꜩaconizah: tzakonisaj — (guess) finish; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('finis par les mordre tous'); respelled by the letters
tiic: tiik — biting; ti 'bite' + -ic, the noun of ti (qui tiic 'their biting')
ꜩubah: tz'ub'aj — suck; transitive verb, the modern tz'ub' 'suck' (cha ꜩubah vi 'suck there'); the tz' and b' supplied on the plain ligature, as ꜩonoh is tz'onoj
culel: kulel — (inferred) seated one(s); a short form of cubulel 'seated ones' (v cab culel 'its second seated one'); not certain, respelled by the letters
xꜭhavic: xch'awik — it spoke; x- completive + ch'aw 'speak' (the v is u) + -ik (mavi xꜭhavic 'it did not speak')
aqui: Aki — Aqui; a cry of pain, 'Ah!' (Brasseur 'Ah! ay!'); kept in K'iche' in the English
xtiic: xtiik — he was bitten; x- completive + ti 'bite' + -ic, passive in sense with no person written
ahi: Aji — Ahi; a cry of pain, 'Ay!'; kept in K'iche' in the English
tiouic: tiowik — (inferred) it bit, that bit; ti 'bite' + -ou, the form with the biter in focus, + -ik (xi tiouic 'it has bitten you', xe tiouic 'that bit them')
hina: jina — (guess) not understood; in xa hina quichila, taken as 'some thing or other'; respelled by the letters
quichila: kichila — (guess) not understood; with hina in xa hina quichila 'some thing or other'; respelled by the letters
vacac: waqaq — (inferred) sixth; the ordinal of 'six' (waqib'), with v- 'its' (v vacac culel 'its sixth seated one')
xti: xti — (inferred) it was bitten; x- completive + ti 'bite', no person written, so passive in sense (ta xti v vvc culel 'when the seventh seated one was bitten'); Brasseur 'au moment où il était également piqué'
vvc: wuq — seventh; the ordinal of wuqub' 'seven' (v vvc culel 'its seventh seated one')
vahxac: wajxaq — eighth; the ordinal of wajxaqib' 'eight' (v vahxac culel 'its eighth seated one')
beleh: b'elej — nine, ninth; the numeral (v beleh culel 'its ninth seated one')
lahuh: lajuj — ten, tenth; the numeral (v lahuh cubulel 'its tenth seated one')
hulah: julaj — (inferred) eleventh; the ordinal of hulahuh 'eleven'; respelled by the letters
cablahuh: kab'lajuj — twelve, twelfth; cab 'two' + lahuh 'ten' (v cablahuh culel 'its twelfth seated one')
roxlahuh: roxlajuj — thirteen, thirteenth; r- + oxlahuh 'thirteen' (ox 'three' + lahuh 'ten'), written without v- (roxlahuh culel 'thirteenth seated one')
quicxic: Kikxik — Quicxic; name of a lord of Xibalba, quic 'blood' + xic 'hawk' (Brasseur, 'Hawk Blood'; inferred); kept as a name, respelled by the letters
cahlahuh: kajlajuj — fourteen, fourteenth; cah 'four' + lahuh 'ten' (v cahlahuh culel 'its fourteenth seated one')
quicrixcac: Kikrixkak — Quicrixcac; name of a lord of Xibalba, quic 'blood' + r- 'its' + ixcac 'nail, claw' (Brasseur 'Blood of the Claws'; inferred); kept as a name, respelled by the letters
quicre: Kikre — Quicre; name of a lord of Xibalba, quic 'blood' + re 'teeth' (Brasseur 'Blood of the Teeth'; inferred); kept as a name, respelled by the letters
holoman: joloman — (guess) head by head, each in turn; perhaps holom 'head' + -an, in huhun chi holoman 'each, head by head'; respelled by the letters
mich: mich — (inferred) pluck out; xu mich 'he plucked out' (Brasseur 'que celui-ci s'arracha'); the modern mich' 'pluck' is not restored
cubulic: kub'ulik — seated; kub'ul 'seated' + -ik (ri cubulic 'the one seated')
tacchiinel: takchiinel — (guess) tempter; not otherwise known, doubtful first letter (t or l; Brasseur lakchiinel), sense after Brasseur 'to tempt them'; respelled by the letters
calainic: kalainik — (inferred) greeting, they greeted; cala 'hail' + -in + -ic; respelled by the letters
calata: kalata — hail, greetings; cala 'hail' + ta, the softening particle (calata Huncame 'greetings, Huncame')
xahauax: xajawax — (inferred) it was wanted; x- completive + ah 'want' + -auax, a passive (the modern ajawax 'be wanted')
xcanai: xkanai — (guess) it was found out; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('que leurs noms n'eussent pas été découverts'), perhaps from can 'seek'; respelled by the letters
catem: qatem — our bench; qa- 'our' + tem 'bench' (Brasseur ka tem), written as one word
chohim: chojim — (inferred) heated; not otherwise known, in chohim abah 'heated stone' (Brasseur 'pierre chauffée'); respelled by the letters
ticaric: tikarik — (inferred) beginning; tikib'a 'begin' with -ar + -ic (v ticaric 'its beginning'); the t is written like an h
tilovic: tilowik — (guess) burning, lit; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('tout allumées'); respelled by the letters

hu: ju — (guess) one, a; hun 'one' without its n (xa ꜫaꜫa hu ꜫex 'only something red in exchange'; hu chil 'just a chil')
ꜫex: q'ex — exchange, replacement; the root of uq'exel 'replacement' (ꜫex v vach 'in exchange for it', inferred; Brasseur 'à la place')
varanel: waranel — (inferred) watchers; war 'sleep' + -an + -el, those who keep the night (Brasseur 'veilleurs')
yocouic: yokowik — (guess) watched over, guarded; not otherwise known, written with plain c (Brasseur yogouic 'ils furent gardés'); respelled by the letters
cachaco: qachako — we have beaten them; ca- 'we' + chac 'defeat' + -o, written as one word with the xe 'them' before it (mi xe cachaco 'we have just beaten them'); Brasseur Mi-x-e ca chako 'Ils sont tombés dans le piège'
achinac: Achinak — who; interrogative, not otherwise known, written with plain c (Brasseur achinak); respelled by the letters, no q restored
alanic: alanik — being borne, bearing; al 'a woman's child' + -ik, the pair of ꜭaholanic (xe alanic 'they were borne')
halan: jalan — different, strange; the modern jalan, from hal 'change' (inferred; halan qui vach 'strange their faces')
tacon: taqon — (inferred) sent for; taq 'send' + -on, the ending of a verb with no object written (xe tacon 'they sent for them'); Brasseur 'les envoyèrent chercher'
chahoc: chajoq — (inferred) to play (ball); written with one a, the letters of chaj 'torch', where 'play' is chaaj elsewhere; chah + -oq (oho chahoc 'come, let us play')
ꜩonox: tz'onox — they were asked; the passive of ꜩonoh 'ask' (xe ꜩonox 'they were asked'); the tz' supplied on the plain ligature, as in tz'onoj
alaba: Alab'a — (guess) who knows; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('Qui saurait dire d'où nous venons?'); respelled by the letters
beco: b'eko — (guess) set going, send into play; be 'go' + -co, taken as a transitive 'make go' (ca beco 'we set it going'); Brasseur 'jetons notre ballon'
hare: jare — (inferred) that one; ha + re, in ma ta hare ta 'not that one'
chil: chil — (guess) not understood; in hu chil 'just a chil'; Brasseur's note gives, from Ximénez's Tesoro, an insect that burns where it passes and a verb 'flay'; respelled by the letters
xzac: xsak — (guess) it was thrown, set in play; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('le jeu commença avec ceux de Xibalba'); written with the short plain z; respelled by the letters
chaa: chaa — (guess) the court, or the flint blade; not clear: perhaps the ball court (chaaj 'play'; Brasseur 'le sol du jeu de paume') or 010's cha; respelled by the letters
naquipala: Naqipala — what is that; naqi 'what' + pa + la, written as one word (naqila 'what' with pa)
